name: korean
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-large-v3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of openai/whisper-large-v3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.543 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2026-09-08. CAVEATS: this one is a marginal claim - FLEURS is 5.16 vs 5.31 base, a 0.15 pp win; only Common Voice (4.24 vs 6.01) is a real margin. Same zero-shot base column caveat as the rest of the BuzzASR suite, and the card prints no decode settings for the baseline.
